title: This is the hardest pill you will ever have to swallow. We waste so much time making excuses for their silence—thinking they didn't see, didn't hear, or didn't understand.
paragraphs: This is the hardest pill you will ever have to swallow. We waste so much time making excuses for their silence—thinking they didn't see, didn't hear, or didn't understand.

Stop lying to yourself to protect the people who were okay with watching you go under. Their inaction was their action. The moment you accept this painful clarity is the moment you stop drowning and start swimming away.
"It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans." - Psalm 118:8
